intro.text: The captain of a crew held prisoner by the Set, who keeps her freezing people's spirits up and leads them in a fight for their freedom.
The Southern Scadrian captain of the airship Brunstell: a tough, strong-willed negotiator who fights the Set to free her crew and then flies Wax and his companions home to Elendel.

items.text: The Set marched Jordis and her surviving crew through the cold mountains to the Sovereign's temple and kept them in a tent under one guard. As her fingers and toes went numb, she crawled among her crew whispering encouragement. When Allik Neverfar freed them and handed out warmth medallions, she armed her people and led them against the Set's soldiers, pushing them back to the edge of the stone field.

Jordis demanded her ship and the Bands back and warned that refusing could mean war, but Wax claimed them by right of salvage. Steris found a deal: Jordis would take the salvaged airship, the kandra would hold the Bands, and Wax would back treaties with the Malwish. Still furious, but knowing the offer was generous, Jordis agreed and promised Wax's group a ride home.
She piloted the ship to Ahlstrom Tower herself, turned down Marasi's invitation to stay, left Wax a set of medallions and flew south that same night.

appearance.text: Like most Southerners she always wears a mask and shows her moods with hand signs. She is much shorter than Wax, with harsh eyes that make some take her for a soldier.

personality.text: Confident and strong-willed, a canny negotiator who will not back down until her crew gets a fair deal. Her temper runs hot, but she keeps it tightly in check.
